intro: Keppel South Central is an office building at 10 Hoe Chiang Road, in Tanjong Pagar, with Keppel recorded as the owner-developer in our project file. An official owner release, as cited in the file, records that the building was completed in January 2025 — not a 2026 TOP — and, at a 15 October 2026 lease-up snapshot, had approximately 60 per cent committed occupancy including documentation, with a further 20 per cent in negotiation. A second-quarter 2027 divestment completion recorded in the same file is a transaction date; it is not building completion and not a tenant handover date. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Keppel South Central fit-out.

sections.heading: Planning your Keppel South Central interior
sections.text:
Because the building is already complete, the useful conversation with Maison is an office fit-out for a new or remaining tenant, not a home renovation and not a construction-progress story. Typical work, once a floor plate and the landlord’s manual are in hand, is a reception joinery wall, workstation storage, meeting-room carpentry, and a pantry run, specified as built-in work rather than as loose, flat-pack furniture. We can present that in a wide floor view or in closer shots of a reception or a pantry. No official floor plate is on file, so typologies and typical floor areas are left blank.

Newport Tower, IOI Central Boulevard Towers and 39 Robinson Road are nearby office links; The Island Residence and CanningHill Piers are nearby residential links only. We will not invent walking times to Tanjong Pagar MRT or to the city, and we will not treat a divestment date as permission to start works.

After a lease or access letter is in hand, record handover conditions, freeze the layout, obtain landlord consent and any fire-safety approvals the scope requires, then fabricate. A moderate office joinery scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your floor plate and permitted use. We are not affiliated with Keppel.
